name: When should I start planning my exit strategy?

mainEntity.name: When should I start planning my exit strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should start planning your exit strategy before you even acquire the investment property. This foresight allows you to make informed purchase decisions that align with your long-term goals and potential market shifts. For instance, knowing you intend to flip might influence renovation choices. Having a clear strategy from the outset helps streamline the process and can minimize risks later on. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution encourages this proactive approach for all investors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan your exit strategy before acquiring an investment property to ensure your purchase aligns with your long-term financial goals.
